_meta.purpose: Independent canonical versification oracle for the Bible Gold Set. Each Bible's per-book chapter tally (derived by span-containment from its frozen gold map) is checked against these externally-established counts, giving map-only marker Bibles an accuracy guarantee that does NOT trust the map's own re-parsed markers.
_meta.scope: protestant_66 counts are universal and externally verifiable (stable since Langton, c.1227) and are strict-gated for every Bible that contains those books. Deuterocanonical chapter divisions vary by tradition (Vulgate folds the Epistle of Jeremiah into Baruch ch.6; KJV keeps it a separate book), so only the well-established KJV-Apocrypha set is strict-gated (idx 219); other traditions' deuterocanon is recorded, not gated, to avoid blessing whatever a map happens to contain. catholic_dr is the ORDERED Douay-Rheims/Clementine-Vulgate canon (idx 108): a Protestant-66 name-keyed table cannot gate it (the Vulgate has Esther 16 with the Greek additions, Daniel 14 with Susanna+Bel, Baruch 6 with the Epistle of Jeremiah, 1 Esdras=Ezra=10 not the Greek 1 Esdras=9), and the original-DR book labels are verbose incipits that defeat name lookup — so it is checked POSITIONALLY against the fixed Vulgate order, each slot confirmed by a label token and gated on the external chapter count.
_meta.book_key: canon._normalize() form: lowercased base name with a leading ordinal where applicable (e.g. '1 samuel', 'song of solomon', 'revelation'). Variant spellings (Vulgate/Old-English) are aliased to these keys by the oracle resolver.
_meta.catholic_dr_entry: {book: canonical display key, match: a lowercased token guaranteed to appear in the DR book label (identity/alignment check), chapters: the externally-established Clementine-Vulgate chapter count}. Order is the fixed Clementine Vulgate sequence: 46 OT + 27 NT + 3-book appendix (Prayer of Manasses, 3 Esdras, 4 Esdras) placed after the New Testament.
_meta.verse_counts: recorded per-Bible in the map's verse_count and the sources manifest, NOT gated here (KJV vs Vulgate vs Masoretic versification differ).
_meta.quran_suras: The Qur'an (idx 29, 107) is structurally flat: its 114 suras are top-level 'chapter' sections with no enclosing 'book', so the Bibles' positional book->chapter oracle does not apply (books_chapters would find nothing). Its externally-established fact is the fixed 114-sura canon, gated as a pure section count by palimpsest.gold.quran_sura_count. Counting 'chapter' specifically avoids inflating the tally with a map's parallel per-sura 'introduction'/'translation' sections.
_meta.novel_chapters: Single-work novels are structurally flat like the Qur'an (top-level 'chapter' sections, no 'book' nesting), so their external accuracy lens is also a pure count -- of the author-fixed chapter total -- gated by palimpsest.gold.novel_chapter_count. Only novels whose chapter division is unambiguous across standard editions are listed here and strict-gated (idx 56 The Last of the Mohicans = 33; idx 71 Dr Jekyll and Mr Hyde = 10). Novels with edition-variable or absent chapter divisions (idx 70 Charlotte Temple, idx 19 The Correspondent) are deliberately omitted and remain structural map-gates, not gated on a contestable count.
